faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.desc: Answers to what clients ask most often. Can't find your question? Reach out to our team directly.
faqs.q1: Do you ship to landlocked Armenia from China?
faqs.a1: Yes, CIO Logistics offers multiple corridors from China to Armenia: sea (via Poti/Batumi, 35-45 days), rail (via Aktau-Georgia, 18-22 days), and air freight (5-7 days). We handle all customs clearance at the EAEU border.
faqs.q2: What documents do I need for customs clearance?
faqs.a2: Typically commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or AWB, and certificate of origin. For dangerous goods, MSDS is required. We provide a full checklist tailored to your shipment.
faqs.q3: How long does delivery from Europe to Yerevan take?
faqs.a3: Road freight from Germany/Italy takes 10-14 days, air freight 3-5 days. Sea+road via Poti is the most economical option at 18-22 days.
faqs.q4: Can you handle dangerous goods (DG / Hazmat)?
faqs.a4: Yes, our team is ADR (road), IMDG (sea), and IATA DGR (air) certified. We handle all 9 hazard classes with proper MSDS documentation.
faqs.a5: Yes, we offer all-risk coverage (ICC A, B, C). Quote includes insurance options or you can purchase separately.
faqs.q6: How can I track my shipment in real-time?
faqs.a6: Every shipment includes a tracking number accessible via our portal or homepage tracker. Email/SMS/WhatsApp updates available.
faqs.q7: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a7: Bank transfer (USD, EUR, RUB, AMD), corporate accounts with NET-30 terms, and major credit cards for online stores.
faqs.q8: Do you provide warehousing in Armenia?
faqs.a8: Yes, we operate bonded and general warehouses in Yerevan with temperature-controlled zones, pick & pack, and inventory management for e-commerce clients.
